text_blocks.snippet: The European Union is implementing a Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), essentially a carbon tax on certain imported goods, starting in 2026. This mechanism aims to prevent "carbon leakage" by ensuring imported goods face a similar carbon price to those produced within the EU, which are subject to the EU Emissions Trading System (ETS).
